2.200.2
RadialPointer.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.ActionInfo element specifies the actions for a RadialPointer. This element is
optional. This element is of type ActionInfo.
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
